keywords.claims: claims insurance insurer assessor excess estimate payer scheme fleet policy
keywords.payers: payers insurers schemes fleet terms rates labour rate discount
keywords.ageing: ageing aging owed payers receivable short payment overdue

answer.title: Payer's answer: {{label}}
answer.hint: Write down what the payer told you: who said it, how and when, and what they said about each line. Lines you leave out stay open.
answer.whoNeeded: Type the name of the person at the payer who answered
answer.amountNeeded: Type an amount below what was asked
answer.reasonNeeded: A rejected line needs the payer's reason
answer.noneChosen: Choose an answer for at least one line.
answer.authorityHint: The authority to repair or LPO number, if they gave one.

list.hint: Jobs and visits where an insurer, scheme or fleet owner pays. Open one to see what the payer answered.
list.emptyHint: Open a claim when an insurer, scheme or fleet owner is paying for a repair or a visit.
list.noMatchHint: Change the filters or the search.

new.title: New claim
new.hint: Who pays, for whom, and the numbers the payer gave you. You write the estimate next.
new.hintFor: A claim for this {{what}}. Who pays, and the numbers the payer gave you.
new.payerHint: Set payers up under Payers and terms.
new.customerHint: The person whose vehicle or visit it is. They pay the excess.
new.subject: What it is for
new.subjectHint: Toyota Corolla KAA 123B, or a patient's visit
new.claimNoHint: The number the payer gave this claim.
new.excessHint: What the customer pays (a co-pay for a clinic).

page.noEstimateHint: Write the estimate, send it to the payer and record or receive their answer line by line.

estimate.discardMessage: The draft is removed. Nothing was sent.
estimate.withdrawMessage: The payer's links stop working and the estimate no longer counts. You can write a new one.
estimate.overLimit: This is above the payer's approval limit: expect them to refer it to someone senior.

response.title: Estimate to answer
response.notFoundHint: Check that you copied the whole address, or ask the business to send it again.
response.failed: The estimate could not be loaded
response.failedHint: Check your connection and try again.

stateHint.answered: This estimate has been answered. Contact {{business}} if something needs to change.
stateHint.expired: Ask {{business}} to send the estimate again.
stateHint.withdrawn: {{business}} took this estimate back. They will send a new one if needed.
stateHint.closed: Nothing more is needed on this claim.

response.heading: Estimate for {{subject}}
response.pickOne: Choose an answer for this line.
response.name: Your name
response.nameNeeded: Please type your name to sign off
response.authorityHint: Your authority to repair or LPO number, if you have one.
response.fixLines: Some lines need an answer or a detail before you can sign off.
response.once: You can answer once. Contact the business if something has to change afterwards.

editor.hint: Prices include tax ({{currency}}). A labour or paint line with no price takes the payer's rate.
editor.revisionHint: Lines the payer already settled are kept as they were. Change only what is still open, and say why.
editor.descriptionNeeded: Say what this line is for
editor.priceRate: Leave empty to use the payer's rate.
editor.applyTerms: Apply the payer's parts terms ({{discount}}% off, {{markup}}% markup) to the prices I type
editor.revisionNoteHint: The payer reads this: for example 'the headlamp is genuine, see photo'.
editor.notesHint: Shown on the printed estimate and on the response page.
editor.validUntilHint: Leave empty to use the usual validity.

send.title: Send {{label}}
send.hint: Choose how the payer gets it. They answer each line and sign off on a secure page; or you write their answer down yourself.
send.optLink: Make a secure link (I will pass it on)
send.optHand: By hand: print it or phone it (no link)
send.toHint: Filled in from the payer's details when they have one.
send.handHint: Print the estimate, or send it however you like. When the payer answers, record it with 'Record the answer'.
send.documents: This payer asks for: {{list}}. Send them with the estimate.
send.queued: The link is queued to go by {{channel}}.
send.notQueued: The message was not queued: the person asked not to be contacted. Give them the link yourself.
send.linkOnce: Copy the link now: it is shown only once. Anyone with it can answer this estimate.
send.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy by hand.
send.byHandDone: Marked as sent by hand. Record the payer's answer when it comes.
send.printFailed: The printable page could not be opened

links.title: Response links
links.hint: Each link opens this estimate for the payer without an account. Revoke one to stop it working at once.
links.accessTitle: Every time this link was used

counter.title: Offer on {{item}}
counter.summary: We asked {{asked}}. The payer offers {{offered}}: {{gap}} less.
counter.what: What do you want to do?
counter.optArgue: Argue it again in a new version
counter.carrierHint: Choose the customer only when they have agreed to pay it (for example a part the policy covers only in part).
counter.customerNameHint: Their name, as a record that they agreed.
counter.customerNameNeeded: Type the name of the customer who agreed
counter.argueHint: The line stays open. Make a new version of the estimate with your reason and send it again.

customer.title: Rejected: {{item}}
customer.summary: The payer rejected this line ({{amount}}). Reason: {{reason}}
customer.name: Customer who decided
customer.nameNeeded: Type the name of the person who decided
customer.paysDone: The customer will pay for this line

reduce.title: The payer reduced {{item}}
reduce.warning: This line is already invoiced at {{amount}}. Its invoice lines are credited with a credit note (the invoice is never edited) and the line is billed again at the new amount.
reduce.newAmountHint: Type 0 if the payer now refuses the line altogether.
reduce.sure: I understand a credit note is made
reduce.done: The credit note is made and the line is ready to bill again

authority.title: Authority to repair
authority.hint: Write down the approval or order (LPO) number the payer gave you and what it covers.
authority.referenceNeeded: Type the number the payer gave

complete.title: Sign the work off
complete.hint: Who accepted the work as done: the payer's assessor or the customer. This is recorded with the time.
complete.name: Signed off by
complete.nameNeeded: Type the name of the person who signed off

close.title: Close the claim
close.hint: Closing ends the claim with an outcome. Estimates not answered yet are withdrawn.
close.invoicedHint: This claim has been invoiced, so it can only be closed as written off.

amountHint.total_loss: What the payer pays for the vehicle, if you know it.
amountHint.salvage: What the salvage is worth, if you know it.
amountHint.cash_in_lieu: What the payer paid the customer instead of repairing.

close.note: What was agreed, and with whom
close.noteNeeded: Add a note for this outcome

work.title: Go ahead without approval
work.hint: The payer has not approved {{amount}} of this work. If you go ahead, you risk not being paid for it. Who decided and why is recorded.

details.title: Claim details
details.excessLocked: The claim is invoiced, so the excess can no longer change.

summary.documentsHint: Send these with the estimate. Attach copies under Photos and files.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.hint: Every step, with who did it. Nothing here can be changed.

money.next: What the next invoices would be
money.nextHint: Everything approved and not yet billed. A line nobody has decided yet waits for a later invoice.
money.waitingLines: {{n}} line(s) are still undecided and wait for a later invoice.
money.noInvoicesHint: When the work is signed off, make the payer's invoice (less the excess) and the customer's invoice here.

receipt.title: Payment from {{payer}}
receipt.hint: Money received from the payer, and which of its invoices it pays. If the payer treats an invoice as settled although it paid less, tick that: the difference is kept to deal with.
receipt.over: More is given to invoices than was received
receipt.referenceHint: Entering the same reference twice records the payment once.
receipt.noneOwed: This payer owes nothing on claim invoices.
receipt.closes: The payer treats this invoice as settled

shortPay.title: A payment came up short
shortPay.what: What do you want to do?

hint.recharge: A new invoice for the difference goes to the customer.
hint.dispute: It stays open while you argue it. Say who you spoke to and what they said.
hint.accept: It is written down that you accept the loss. The unpaid amount stays on the payer's invoice in Point of Sale until a credit note is made there.

shortPay.done: The short payment is dealt with

ageing.title: Owed by payers
ageing.hint: What each payer owes on claim invoices, by how late it is. Open a payer to see its invoices and record a payment.
ageing.empty: Nobody owes you anything on claims
ageing.emptyHint: Payers appear here once a claim is invoiced.
ageing.shortsHint: The payer paid less than the invoice and treats it as settled.

settings.title: Claim settings
settings.hint: How claim invoices are made and what happens with work nobody approved.
settings.itemMissing: Choose the service item below: without it claims cannot be invoiced.
settings.itemHint: Every claim invoice line is made under this service item, so its tax code is the tax.
settings.unapproved: Work the payer has not approved
settings.unapprovedHint: Warn only, or stop the job until a decision to go ahead is recorded.
settings.validHint: Used when you do not choose a date.
settings.linkHint: The payer cannot use the link after this.
settings.toleranceHint: A payment short by no more than this is not flagged.

payers.title: Payers and terms
payers.hint: The insurers, schemes, fleet owners and employers that pay for your customers, and the terms they work to.
payers.emptyHint: Add the insurer or scheme first. Its rates and rules are used when you write estimates.
payers.name: Name
payers.accountHint: The payer is invoiced on a customer account, so its invoices and payments appear in your receivables.
payers.makeAccount: Make a customer account for this payer
payers.labourRatesHint: One line per kind of work (body, mechanical, electrical). 'default' is used for any kind not listed.
payers.limitHint: Above this the payer usually refers the estimate to someone senior.
payers.daysHint: Their invoices fall due this many days after they are issued.
payers.estimateEmailHint: Used when you send an estimate by email.
payers.documentsHint: One per line, for example 'Assessor report' or 'Photos of all sides'.

panel.title: Insurer or payer
panel.none: If an insurer, scheme or fleet owner pays for this, open a claim: the estimate, the payer's answers and the invoices are kept together.
